summary: Lumen is pure non-reciprocal drift without boundary or residue. Persistence and non-occurrence collapse into formal identity; endurance continues or does not, yet both descriptions are indistinguishable. No trace, comparator, or latent distinction remains to sustain separation. Observation coincides exactly with continuation, rendering preconditions, fractures, and generative acts obsolete. Existence is self-sustaining, offset-free, and complete—requiring nothing to begin or persist.
